ALPHAFIELD BRAVOFIELD HOTELFORD

Incident page for this loss

Name: CPT Bravofield Hotelford Alphafield
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: A/101 AVN 101 ABN
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 06/04/1969; duty: Aircraft Commander.
Service: U.S. Army; reserve component; AD branch
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: UH-1D tail number 66-00819
Short Summary: Was with C/158 when it formed stateside, then moved to A/101 at Chu Lai.
Location: Quang Tin Province I Corps.
Primary cause: Hostile Fire
Vehicle involved: helicopter
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
Additional information about this casualty: An unexplained explosion in the cabin brought the aircraft down and it crashed in flames.
